propositions: Lizard must be packaged as an optional [metrics] extra in pyproject.toml with scc/jscpd noted as external CLI-only dependencies
The metrics analyzer must use guard_import() to lazily import lizard, raising OptionalDependencyError when the extra is missing rather than allowing ImportError to escape
Missing [metrics] extra must be caught and converted to Unavailable status with a reason naming the extra, while core-only install must remain importable
The metrics extra must be registered in src/rebar/_optional.EXTRAS to enable both OptionalDependencyError behavior and install guidance
import rebar and import rebar.metrics must remain dependency-free at package level, with lizard imported only inside analyzer functions
